# The swarm starts the ready tasks by priority, no more than the free slots, and it never runs more agents than the slots.
# The backlog holds P2, P3, P0 and P1 tasks, in that order, and the config has two logins. The first two agents are the P0 and the P1 task.
isolate
swarmfakes

exec beehaveswarm item add swarm swarm-1 --title 'The swarm' --body-file backlog.txt
exec beehaveswarm run swarm-1 swarm --workflow swarm/workflow.star

# Four tasks ran, and the first two to start were the P0 task and the P1 task.
grep -count=4 '^task ' calls.log
# The two lines are matched as a set: the order of two concurrent first writes is not defined.
exec head -n 2 calls.log
stdout 'task swarm-4'
stdout 'task swarm-5'

# No more than two agents ran at once.
! grep '^[3-9]$' concurrency.log

# All four landed.
grep -count=4 '^MergePR ' forge/calls.log

-- backlog.txt --
P2	two	c.txt
P3	three	d.txt
P0	zero	a.txt
P1	one	b.txt
